info.title: CISLIB Central Management API
info.description: Authenticated Central Management with nineteen fixed configuration operations alongside thirteen existing APIs. Installed feature discovery reflects actual initialized backend capabilities; specifications do not imply all handlers are enabled. Runtime configuration does not renew managed-work authority.

get.summary: Confirm current management prerequisites through the authoritative backend
get.description: Requires trusted self mapping and exact retained registration ownership. A live backend check returns a persisted authority ID, opaque control revision and per-attempt echo. Missing/closed/foreign registrations or unavailable/untrusted backend never renew admission. No automatic read retries; each later exchange uses a fresh attempt UUID.

parameters.description: Exactly one canonical UUID for this exchange, echoed unchanged. It is not an operation key or credential.
parameters.name: attemptId

200.description: Current authoritative confirmation, independent of presence and business permissions. Usable freshness starts at the local monotonic request entry; delayed cleanup cannot grant a new window.
